}

model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

job_ids = list(jobs.keys())
n = len(job_ids)

C = model.addVars(job_ids, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")  # Completion times
T = model.addVars(job_ids, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")  # Tardiness
x = model.addVars(job_ids, job_ids, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")  # Sequencing variables

# Objective: Minimize the total weighted tardiness
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in job_ids), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Constraints
M = sum(jobs[j]["processing_time"] for j in job_ids)  # Big M

# Completion time constraints
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"])

# Tardiness constraints
for j in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"])

# Sequencing constraints
for i in job_ids:
    for j in job_ids:
        if i != j:
            model.addConstr(C[i] + M * x[i, j] <= C[j] + M - jobs[i]["processing_time"])

# Each job must be scheduled exactly once
for i in job_ids:
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in job_ids if i != j) == 1)
    model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in job_ids if i != j) == 1)

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = []
for i in job_ids:
    for j in job_ids:
        if i != j and x[i, j].X > 0.5:
            sequence.append((i, j))

# Reconstruct the job order
job_order = []
current_job = next(j for j in job_ids if all(x[i, j].X < 0.5 for i in job_ids if i != j))
while len(job_order) < n:
    job_order.append(current_job)
    current_job = next(j for j in job_ids if x[current_job, j].X > 0.5)

# Output the result
result = {
    "sequence": job_order,
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}
